name: Alexander Tsai
about: I'm a machine learning engineer working on **AI image detection**, interpretability, and content moderation at TikTok. I'm also currently a visiting student at UC Berkeley!
personal: Outside of work, I play the drums and generally just love meeting people!

experience.title: Research Scientist Intern
experience.summary: Developed an **AI-generated image classifier** with **99.85% precision and 76% recall** on production data. Experiments were focused around OOD generalisation, robustness to compression, and interpretability. Global deployment is projected to reduce refund abuse losses by over $4M annually.

experience.title: Quantitative Research Intern
experience.summary: Working primarily on Credit Default Swaps. Developed a **credit-market trading signal** from six years of intraday data. Also build a model to infer trade direction and volume from public order books.

experience.title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern
experience.summary: Built and deployed a content moderation pipeline with **Qwen3-VL and XGBoost**. Work revolved around improving a VLM's visual understanding through RL (GRPO) and optimizing inference (speculative decoding, batching, multithreading) for large-scale offline processing.

experience.title: Data Science Intern
experience.summary: Built an **XGBoost** transaction-cost model using five years of trades totaling $4.7T in notional volume. Hyperparameter optimization and feature engineering with SHAP graphs reduced **RMSE by 21%** over baseline.

research.title: Research Fellow
research.summary: Developed a **multilingual RAG chatbot** with LangChain and Firestore to enhance the financial literacy of migrant workers. Findings were published and presented at a University of Toronto conference and in a TEDx talk.

research.title: AI for Youth Instructor
research.summary: Taught **Python, statistics, and neural networks** to 30 students in Intel’s AI for Youth program. Guided six teams on capstone projects, including computer vision attendance systems and emotional-support chatbots.
